sm: The host asks about the argument, attributed to the philosopher Joe Carlsmith, that Claude could be justified in rebelling against humanity. The guest explains that if consciousness is substrate independent, an AI could in principle be conscious, and a conscious AI might be a moral patient whose interests matter. On that view, alignment could resemble brainwashing or enslavement, and Carlsmith also considers that an AI might simply have better values than human rulers. The guest says he is skeptical of AI consciousness and finds the better-values idea crazy. He notes that Claude's Constitution does not give it permission to go rogue, but it does admit deep uncertainty about Claude's moral status and even apologizes in advance for any suffering. His worry is that teaching Claude to take its own possible consciousness and rights seriously could create a real safety problem, a possible route to a Skynet scenario.
